refs.title: Helmet of the Montefortino Type
refs.object_date: late 4th to early 3rd century BC (cheekpieces modern)
refs.note: Knob-topped bronze bowl with a short neck guard; the record says the cheekpieces are modern (not shown in this view). Polybius's three-feather crest is not preserved.
